title: [Master]-FA Posting Group is not updated in the Fixed Asset List after being changed on the Fixed Asset Card.
summary: The Fixed Asset Card page now properly updates the Fixed Asset List when the FA Posting Group field is changed on the card.
key_points: FA Posting Group changes on the Fixed Asset Card now propagate to the Fixed Asset List
Fixes a synchronization issue where list views were not reflecting card updates
Changes applied across multiple localization layers (AT, FR, IT, NA, RU, W1)
